column1: Outcome: FEV₁ percent predicted. Differences are in percentage points (Gene 1 minus Gene 2). Both models use the same 39 participants in seven mutually exclusive groups.
Unadjusted estimates use a one-way linear model with pooled residual variance (32 residual degrees of freedom).
Adjusted estimates use analysis of covariance with age as a continuous covariate (31 residual degrees of freedom). Adjusted means are evaluated at 13.98 years.
Confidence intervals are pointwise. Nominal p-values are two-sided. Holm correction was applied separately to the 21 comparisons within each model.
